array.string: /usr/bin/pgrep -qx Decaffeinate && exit 0 /usr/bin/pmset -g | /usr/bin/grep -q 'SleepDisabled[[:space:]]*1' && /usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/bin/pmset -a disablesleep 0 d=io.github.dstmrk.decaffeinate /usr/bin/defaults read $d heldClosed > /dev/null 2>&1 && /usr/bin/defaults delete $d heldClosed && /usr/sbin/ioreg -r -k AppleClamshellState -d 1 | /usr/bin/grep -q '"AppleClamshellState" = Yes' && /usr/bin/pmset sleepnow /usr/bin/defaults read $d savedPowerMode > /dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0 k=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g custom | /usr/bin/awk '$1 == "powermode" || $1 == "lowpowermode" { print $1; exit }') for f in -b -c; do v=$(/usr/bin/defaults export $d - | /usr/bin/plutil -extract savedPowerMode.$f raw -o - -) || continue; /usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/bin/pmset $f $k $v || exit 0; done /usr/bin/defaults delete $d savedPowerMode
